generationInputs.prompt: A mature adult female with long, wavy, light gray hair and fair skin stands behind a countertop. She is smiling and looking directly at the camera. She wears light-colored framed eyeglasses, noticeable earrings, a subtle necklace, a gray v-neck top, and a light-colored cardigan. On the countertop in front of her are two speckled orange fruits, one green fruit, and two more green fruits in a teal and brown bowl. The background features a light-colored backsplash, two wooden shelves, and various kitchen items including potted plants, canisters, and a metal kettle visible on the left side. The lighting appears soft and natural.
